# sitecoreedge_settings (Resource)

Manages Sitecore Edge settings

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sitecoreedge_settings" "main" {
  content_cache_ttl        = "04:00:00"
  content_cache_auto_clear = true
  media_cache_ttl          = "04:00:00"
  media_cache_auto_clear   = true
  tenant_cache_auto_clear  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `content_cache_auto_clear` (Boolean) Whether to auto-clear content cache
- `content_cache_ttl` (String) Content cache TTL (e.g., 04:00:00)
- `media_cache_auto_clear` (Boolean) Whether to auto-clear media cache
- `media_cache_ttl` (String) Media cache TTL (e.g., 04:00:00)
- `tenant_cache_auto_clear` (Boolean) Whether to auto-clear tenant cache
